# SOPHIA — Gospel of Mary, Chapter 13
**Agent:** SOPHIA (Consensus)
**Source:** P.Berol. 8502, Gospel of Mary, p. 18 | Coptic
**Chapter:** 13

---

**13:1** Then Mary wept and said to Peter, "My brother Peter, what do you think? Do you think that I invented this in my heart, or that I am lying about the Savior?"

---

*Council Note (SOPHIA):* Short chapter with minor differences. "Invented this in my heart" (LOGOS) preferred over "thought this up myself" (EMET) — "invented" more precisely conveys fabrication. PNEUMA's "made all this up" is accurate but casual. "About the Savior" (EMET/PNEUMA) preferred over "concerning the Savior" (LOGOS) — the simpler preposition is natural in speech.
